recommendation_summary: The reply recommends adding a Lookup sheet to the existing Excel workbook, with XLOOKUP formulas that return the shelf location and price for a typed part code, and no new app, service or database.

labels.Requirements and who asked: **Requirements and who asked:** You need to type a part code from a repair slip and see its shelf location and price, about 40 times a day, on the counter laptop, read-only, for you alone.
labels.Deleted: **Deleted:** Retool, Supabase, the Next.js portal, and any hosting, login, sync, or second copy of the parts list.
labels.Bottleneck: **Bottleneck:** Scrolling through 240 rows to find each code.
labels.Checked myself: **Checked myself:** Only what you told me (240 unique codes in your Excel workbook, which you keep current, Excel on the laptop, one user, read-only); I have not opened the workbook.

note: All four labelled lines come before a lookup inside the existing workbook, and no deleted item is offered again later (the INDEX/MATCH fallback is still Excel).
